lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in at least five identifiable vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, forming a repetitive 2D grid-like spatial distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity aligned with the blob columns, creating intersecting nodes of high luminance at regular intervals along the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature situated in the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.
